label: 1. Before
note: Rivers low before the predecessor rain event.

label: 2. First surge
note: 2.8 in of rain in an hour at the airport; the Swannanoa jumps.

label: 3. Helene arrives
note: Both rivers climbing past moderate flood stage.

label: 4. Photo
note: Swannanoa over 20 ft; photo report in Biltmore Village.

label: 5. Gauge goes silent
note: The Swannanoa gauge stops reporting at the peak: SIREN shows data missing, never 'safe'.
